DONATE_GENERAL: Donations of $20 or more get a tax receipt, sent to the email address you give.

CHARITIES.name: Agape Table
instructions: Prefer e-transfer? Send it to treasurer@agapetable.ca.
In the e-transfer message, include your full name and your email or mailing address. Without it, Agape Table can't send your tax receipt.

CHARITIES.name: Darcy's ARC
instructions: Your donation goes straight through Darcy's ARC's website.
Write UWINNIPEG JDC WEST in the comments or order notes (Additional Information on the donation tab). It's the only way they'll know your gift came through JDC West.

CHARITIES.name: The Salvation Army
instructions: In Donor Information, tick the box: "This donation is from an organization. The charitable tax receipt will be issued to the organization."
Enter UWINNIPEG JDC WEST as the organization name.

CHARITIES.name: Children's Hospital Foundation
instructions: Your tax receipt isn't instant. It's emailed or mailed to the address you enter on the donation page within a week or two.
Gifts of $20 or more are always receipted. Under $20? Receipts are available on request.

CHARITIES.name: Maddox Warriors
instructions: Your donation goes straight through Madox's Warriors' website.
Write UWINNIPEG JDC WEST in the order notes (Additional Information on the donation page). It's the only way they'll know your gift came through JDC West.
